MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Trend champion is catboost (avg_trend_corr=1.0), while seasonality champion is ONLY_FT_catboost (avg_seasonal_corr=0.3303), showing split expertise. Overall champion ONLY_CWT_catboost dominates with RMSE=23.22 and excels at both horizons. Extreme RMSE spread (95.19) and high seasonality variance (0.776) indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to combine trend/seasonality specialists while exploiting additive decomposition structure.
